C015_MorseSmale_snapshot07-09-26.json.theorem: Sublemma R0: for a centered stationary C^3 Gaussian field on T_L^2 under (H1+)(H2'), almost surely there is no gradient trajectory whose alpha-limit and omega-limit are two distinct index-1 saddles (no saddle-saddle heteroclinic connection). Equivalently W^u(p) is transverse to W^s(q) for every ordered pair (p,q) of index-1 saddles - the Morse-Smale property on which the elder-rule pairing's a.s. well-definedness rests.

architecture.geometry: under ascent flow x' = grad f, index-1 saddles in 2D have 1-dim W^u and 1-dim W^s. A connection p->q is a shared orbit in W^u(p) cap W^s(q); two 1-manifolds sharing a 1-dim orbit in a 2-manifold is a codimension-1 (nontransverse) event. Morse-Smale <=> all such intersections transverse <=> no shared orbit (an isolated transverse point cannot be a whole orbit).
architecture.defect_functional: for a candidate connection, fix a transversal Sigma to the flow at an interior point x0 strictly between p and q; the connection DEFECT D(f) = signed separation on Sigma between the forward image of W^u(p) and the backward image of W^s(q). D = 0 iff a connection through x0 exists.
architecture.submersion_step: Cameron-Martin perturbation f -> f + h changes D by the linearized-flow response to the forcing grad h along the orbit; the derivative h -> dD is SURJECTIVE (onto R) provided grad h(x0) can be prescribed freely in R^2 while holding the saddle conditions grad f(p)=grad f(q)=0 and the Hessian types fixed. Free interior steering => D is a submersion in h.
architecture.the_named_crux: GAUSSIAN PARAMETRIC TRANSVERSALITY (open): submersion of D in the Cameron-Martin direction gives, by finite-dim Thom transversality, that for a.e. h the perturbed field has D_h transverse to 0; translating 'a.e. h (Cameron-Martin)' to 'a.s. f (Gaussian law)' UNIFORMLY over the continuum of candidate (p,q,orbit) configurations is a Malliavin/Sard-type covering argument with no off-the-shelf reference. THIS is the sole remaining obligation after this cycle.

design.recompute: regenerate fields from stored seeds; re-detect critical points (identical pipeline); reconstruct mutual pairs and window points; at each pair member compute the Hessian at the converged Newton point (bilinear jets)
design.statistic_primary: Dhat_S := |det Hess(x_S)| / (kappa_hat * r), kappa_hat := 6*ell/r^3 per pair -- the finite-r proxy for |mu_tilde|
design.statistic_controls: Dhat_M (same at x_M); Tsoft := |f_tt_soft(x)| / (kappa_hat * r) where f_tt_soft = eigenvalue of smaller magnitude (soft direction)
design.groups: WINDOW pairs: r in [0.45, 0.85], hosting >=1 window point at d <= 3r, classified by NEAREST member (S-events vs M-events); CONTROL pairs: same r-bin, no window point within delta=2; matched by r-bin (4 log bins of C006-A1)
design.bootstrap: seed-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, on median ratios; Holm correction over the 3 registered predictions
design.power_guard: if #window-pairs (either member class) < 15, that class is UNDERPOWERED (registered escape; no adjudication)

registered_predictions.P-1c-1 (depletion, same side): median Dhat_(near member) over window pairs / median Dhat over matched controls <= 0.80; 95% bootstrap CI excludes 1.0. Scenario grading: <=0.60 Optimistic; (0.60,0.80] Nominal; CI includes 1.0 => FLAT-TAIL EXPLANATION OF THE C006 EXCESS IS FALSIFIED
registered_predictions.P-1c-2 (reweighted slope): reweighting each pair's N_w by Dhat_S (E[N_w*Dhat]/E[Dhat] per bin, same 4-bin log fit as C006-A1) increases the point slope by >= +0.40 relative to the unweighted point slope 1.44

P-1c-3 (adversarial controls, BOTH must.C-1 side-asymmetry: far-side depletion strictly weaker: median-ratio(far member det) - median-ratio(near member det) >= +0.10 (the O(r) M-S Hessian correlation permits partial far-side depletion; equality or reversal => interpretation is an artifact of the pair event, not of the mechanism)
P-1c-3 (adversarial controls, BOTH must.C-2 soft-curvature null: Tsoft median ratio (window/control) within [0.85, 1.15] in BOTH groups (the soft eigenvalue is pinned to kappa*r by the fold conditioning and CANNOT deplete; violation => chart/detector artifact, halt interpretation)

branch_adjudication_precommitted.P1c1 FAIL (CI includes 1): flat-tail explanation of the near-zone excess FALSIFIED; excess reassigned to the gamma=1 annulus mechanism; O2 priority jump; the Lemma's r^5 UPPER bound is NOT affected (it is an asymptotic statement; only its finite-u explanatory claim dies)
branch_adjudication_precommitted.C2 FAIL: instrument artifact: no interpretation of P-1c-1/2 permitted; detector Hessian audit before anything else
branch_adjudication_precommitted.P1c2 fail with P1c1 pass: depletion real but not the dominant driver of the slope deficit; mixed mechanism recorded; O2 required

proof: Exponential tilting of a joint Gaussian shifts the full mean by Cov((H,X),X)theta and leaves covariance unchanged.

The union bound licenses addition of the interceptor, Gamma, and collar probabilities.
